subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements is correct about privatisation?

**Statements:**

I. It promotes economic efficiency

II. It delimits the interference of bureaucracy

III. It leads to market failure
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only statements I and II**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• I. It promotes economic efficiency:
 
 
• This **statement is Correct**
 
• Privatisation** often leads to increased economic efficiency because private entities are motivated by profit** and tend to allocate resources more efficiently than public enterprises.
 
• Competition among private players encourages innovation, better services, and cost-effectiveness.
 
 

 
• II. It delimits the interference of bureaucracy:
 
 
• This **statement is also Correct**
 
• **Privatisation reduces the role of government and bureaucracy in economic activities. **
 
• **This often leads to faster decision-making, less red tape, and a more business-friendly environment.**
